senses.definition: A broad and bifid P wave on an electrocardiogram, most commonly observed in lead II, usually caused by enlargement of the left atrium.
A high, narrow and peaked P wave on an electrocardiogram, most commonly observed in leads II and III, usually caused by enlargement of the right atrium.
A trap in a waste pipe consisting of a U-bend followed by a 90-degree bend to the horizontal or near horizontal, so that the entire device is shaped like the letter P on its side.
An interjection in response to smelling an unpleasant scent.
senses.example: What is that awful smell? P U!

senses.definition: A wave on an electrocardiogram that represents the electrical changes generated by the depolarization of the atria.
The time from the onset of the P wave to the onset of the atrial electrogram, normally 27 ± 18 ms.

A norm for the rational numbers, with some prime number p as parameter, such that any rational number of the form pᵏ(a/b) — where a, b and k are integers and a, b and p are coprime — is mapped to the rational number p⁻ᵏ and 0 is mapped to 0. (Note: any nonzero rational number can be reduced to such a form.)

senses.definition: Of a positive integer n, the exponent of the highest power of p that divides n. Often denoted νₚ(n). For example, ν₂(48)=4.

A function of rational numbers, with prime number p as parameter, which is defined for some non-zero integer x as the largest integer r such that pʳ divides x; is defined for some non-zero rational number a/b as the p-adic ordinal of a minus the p-adic ordinal of b; and is defined for 0 as infinity.
senses.example: Notice the resemblance between the p-adic ordinal and the base-p logarithm.

senses.definition: The ultrametric with prime number p as parameter defined as d_p(x,y)=|x-y|ₚ; i.e., such that the distance between two rational numbers is equal to the p-adic absolute value of the difference between those two numbers.
senses.example: On p-adic ultrametrics in the genome / In previous section we demonstrated that codons and amino acids are elements of some p-adic ultrametric spaces.

senses.definition: The time from the onset of the P wave to the first high-frequency component of the bundle of His electrogram, normally 119 ± 38 ms.
An interface between a p-type and n-type semiconductor; used to create junction diodes and junction transistors
senses.example: In this way a pn-junction can be used as a diode – it can allow a current to flow, but only in one direction.
